create_fsdp_config: create an fsdp_config dataclass instance with default FSDP distributed training settings
configure_fsdp_sharding_strategy: configure the fsdp_config sharding_strategy to FULL_SHARD, HYBRID_SHARD, SHARD_GRAD_OP, or NO_SHARD
configure_fsdp_mixed_precision: configure the fsdp_config mixed_precision and use_fp16 flags for mixed precision training
configure_fsdp_checkpointing: configure the fsdp_config checkpoint_type to SHARDED_STATE_DICT or FULL_STATE_DICT for model saving
configure_fsdp_hsdp: configure the fsdp_config hsdp flag with sharding_group_size and replica_group_size for hybrid sharding
